title: AudioLab Audio Cutter & Editor
summary: Trim audio, record voice, cut MP3, create ringtones, mix songs - all in one app.
description:
AudioLab - The Only Audio Editor App You Will Ever Need
Edit, Record, and Create Audio - All in One App
AudioLab is a powerful audio editor and voice recorder designed for anyone who wants to edit audio, record voice, cut MP3s, or create custom ringtones on Android. Whether you’re editing music, recording voice notes, making podcasts, or creating ringtones, AudioLab provides professional audio tools in a simple, easy-to-use app.

From quick trimming to advanced editing and conversion, AudioLab helps you turn raw sound into polished audio in just a few taps.

🎧 Audio Editor & MP3 Cutter
Edit audio files precisely using a clean and intuitive audio editor.
   ●  Cut, trim, split, and merge audio tracks
   ●  MP3 cutter for songs, voice clips, and music files
   ●  Trim audio accurately and save the best parts
   ●  Merge multiple audio files into one
   ●  Edit music tracks without losing quality
Try AudioLab now and create your perfect sound!

🎙️ Voice Recorder & Audio Recorder
Capture clear, high-quality sound with the built-in voice recorder and audio recorder.
   ●  Record voice, music, podcasts, and meetings
   ●  Adjust volume and improve clarity
   ●  Save recordings instantly and edit them later
Ideal for students, content creators, and everyday voice recording needs.

🔄 Audio Converter & MP3 Converter
Convert audio files quickly and easily with AudioLab’s audio converter.
   ●  Convert between MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, M4A, and more
   ●  Compress audio files for easier sharing
   ●  Convert video to audio and extract sound from videos
A simple solution for managing multiple audio formats on your phone.

🎶 Music Maker, Song Maker & Beat Tools
Create and experiment with sound using AudioLab’s creative tools.
   ●  Mix multiple audio tracks
   ●  Adjust speed, pitch, and tempo
   ●  Create songs, remixes, and basic beats
   ●  Enhance audio with an equalizer and sound effects
AudioLab works as a lightweight music maker and song maker for quick ideas and edits.

🔔 Ringtone Maker & Audio Customization
Turn any audio file into a custom ringtone or notification sound.
   ●  Create ringtones from songs or recordings
   ●  Set audio as a ringtone, alarm, or notification
   ●  Edit the ringtone length and volume easily
Personalize your phone with sounds that match your style.

Why Choose AudioLab?
   ●  All-in-one audio editor, recorder, and converter
   ●  Clean interface and easy to use
   ●  Powerful tools for advanced users
   ●  Free to use with no complex setup
AudioLab combines all essential audio tools into one app, saving you time, storage, and effort.

Download AudioLab today and master your sound!

AudioLab - Audio Editor Recorder & Ringtone Maker uses FFmpeg under LGPL

Download AudioLab - Audio Editor Recorder & Ringtone Maker today & transform the way you edit music, record & create ringtones
